issuer.name: Not disclosed ('Virtual cards are issued by licensed partners in their respective jurisdictions'; Kripicard 'is not a bank, financial institution, Visa, Mastercard, or payment network'). Platform operated by Uweb3 Management BR (Terms and Conditions, effective 13 Jun 2026; Brazilian law, Rio de Janeiro courts).

funding.supported_assets_note: Cards are loaded with USDT ('basic tier opens with an email and a USDT top-up'); balance and billing in USD; 4% funding fee plus $1 processing per load; crypto-to-fiat conversion carries a 'small margin' (not quantified). Visa or Mastercard BIN chosen at issuance.

eligibility.usage_note: No list of served countries: pages say 'Global', '190+ countries' or '200+ countries' (acceptance and availability framings mixed) and 'Availability may vary by jurisdiction and eligibility'. 'If you are in a sanctioned jurisdiction … service will be denied' — no list. Terms: at least 18 and legal capacity. Not read: any clause restricting the card to one territory or banning solicitation elsewhere (none found in the Terms).

kyc.thresholds_note: Official pages state that the basic tier 'requires only an email address' — 'No passport scan, no proof of address, no selfie' — and that ID verification is collected 'only on tier upgrade' to raise limits. BUT no page gives the spending threshold or limit of the email-only tier ('Exact numbers vary by region and partner bank; see the Fees page'), and the Fees page limits ($25,000/day, $150,000/month) are not attributed to a tier. Per the catalogue rule, 'not required initially' is recorded only when the triggering thresholds are published — hence 'unknown'.
kyc.stages_note: Sign-up: 'Email and password, then turn on two-factor authentication'; card creation after a USDT top-up (minimum $10). Terms: banking partners may request 'additional KYC / source-of-funds documentation' before releasing balances; KYT monitoring at all tiers. Fee page adds chargeback/refund-rate conditions (< 15%) and bans high-risk platforms (Steam, Uber, OnlyFans named).

access.note: No subscription; pay per card issued and per top-up.

fees.conditions: 'Card issuance: $5 per card' ('Negotiable for volume or recurring monthly issuance'); minimum $10 loaded as starting balance ('Not a fee'); unlimited cards per account; card validity 5 years.
'Funding fee: 4%, applied to the amount loaded onto the card' plus 'Processing fee: $1'; minimum top-up $1 after creation. 'Fees may vary depending on funding method or exchange rate.'
'FX fee: 0.00%'; 'Authorization fee: 0.00%'. Network exchange rate applies on non-USD purchases.
USDT→USD conversion 'carries a small margin' — not quantified.
Virtual card only; ATM not mentioned.

limits.note: 'Single transaction: $25,000 per authorization'; 'Daily transaction: $25,000'; 'Monthly transaction: $150,000'. Not attributed to a verification tier.

changelog.reason: Initial record (single read, unattended research run; no-KYC track candidate) from home.kripicard.com: Fees & Pricing, Terms and Conditions (13 Jun 2026), FAQ (answers not rendered), two 'no-KYC' marketing pages and the affiliate page — the first run in which kripicard.com pages were returned by web search. Fees and limits published; operator named (Uweb3 Management BR, Brazil); issuer not disclosed. KYC recorded as 'unknown' because the email-only entry tier is stated without any published threshold or tier limit. Eligibility unknown (no country list). Conversion margin and ATM unknown. Affiliate programme exists without a published commission.

editorial.summary: USDT-funded virtual Visa/Mastercard sold per card ($5) with a 4% + $1 loading fee, no monthly fee and no FX mark-up; limits $25,000 per day and $150,000 per month. The operator is a Brazilian company (Uweb3 Management BR); the card issuer is not disclosed. Marketing pages describe an email-only entry tier with ID checks reserved for limit upgrades, but no threshold for that tier is published, so the verification stage is recorded as unknown.
good_for: One-off or disposable virtual cards for online payments funded with USDT
Users who accept a 4% + $1 loading cost in exchange for no monthly fee
not_for: Everyday spending: 4% per load is far above most cards' FX fees
Anyone who needs a named issuer, a country list or published verification thresholds
Cash withdrawals or physical card use (virtual only)
watch_outs: The card issuer is not named anywhere read; cards are 'issued by licensed partners in their respective jurisdictions'. Funds may be held pending 'additional KYC / source-of-funds documentation' requested by banking partners.
The email-only tier is described on marketing pages only; its spending limit is not published and the FAQ page says Visa/Mastercard cards 'require some KYC due to AML rules'.
Pages disagree on the network (Visa only vs Visa or Mastercard chosen at issuance) and on the footprint ('170+', '190+', '200+ countries').
Chargeback/refund rates above 15% and 'high-risk platforms' (Steam, Uber, OnlyFans named) are grounds for restriction.
The USDT→USD conversion margin is not quantified; 'Fees may vary depending on funding method or exchange rate'.
